title: Design Strategy Ecosystem Services Literature Review Paper
description: Schema for structured paper extraction records used in the design-strategy ecosystem-services literature review.

paper_id.description: Unique identifier of the paper record.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier of the paper.

design_strategy.description: Design strategies identified in the paper.

ecosystem_services.description: Ecosystem services highlighted in the paper.

locations.description: Geographic locations mentioned in the study.

review_required.description: Whether a human review is required for this record.

value.description: The identified design strategy value or label.

evidence.description: Evidence or citation excerpt supporting the identified strategy.

page.description: Page number where the evidence appears.

country.description: Country where the location is situated.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, if known.

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, if known.

evidence.description: Evidence or citation excerpt describing the location.

page.description: Page number where the location is mentioned.
